description: HORAIRES SNCF is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Horaires théoriques et en temps réel de la SNCF Théorique: les horaires des lignes TER, Intercités et TGV opérées par la SNCF Voyageurs pour les 151j à venir, sont fournis au format GTFS et au format NeTEx (qui est la norme technique européenne pour l'échange de données de transport). Coverage: France. The portal files it under Horaires et itinéraires. Its keywords are GTFS, GTFS-RT, SIRI LITE, Horaires, NeTEx, Temps réel. The portal shows 2025-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
